cues.zh: 2009年，在Google的早期，我们开始研发自动驾驶汽车。
cues.en: Back in 2009, in our early days at Google, we started working on self-driving cars.

cues.zh: 如今，我们叫Waymo，我们的全自动驾驶汽车已经上路了。
cues.en: Today, we're called Waymo and our fully self-driving cars are on the road.

cues.zh: 它们采用了一系列我们从零开始构建的技术
cues.en: They use a range of technology we've built from the ground up

cues.zh: 来理解周围的世界，把你送到目的地。
cues.en: to understand the world around them and get you where you need to go.

cues.zh: 你即将看到这一切是如何运作的，以及乘坐我们的车是什么感觉。
cues.en: You're about to see how it all works, and what it feels like to ride in our car.

cues.zh: 行驶时，Waymo使用LiDAR，每秒发射数百万束激光
cues.en: As it drives, Waymo uses LiDAR which sends out millions of laser beams per second

cues.zh: 来构建周围360度世界的详细图像。
cues.en: to build up a detailed picture of the world all 360 degrees around it.

cues.zh: 它还使用雷达来探测物体的距离和速度。
cues.en: It also uses radar to detect how far away objects are and their speed.

cues.zh: 高分辨率摄像头则检测视觉信息，比如交通信号灯是红是绿。
cues.en: And high-resolution cameras detect visual information like whether a traffic signal is red or green.

cues.zh: 然后它把所有数据结合起来，理解周围的世界。
cues.en: It then combines all that data to understand the world around it.

cues.zh: 比如，在这一瞬间，它能准确知道自己位于路上的什么位置。
cues.en: For example, in this fraction of a second, it knows exactly where it is on the road.

cues.zh: 它还能全方位360度识别周围的一切。
cues.en: It can also identify everything around it in full 360 degrees.

cues.zh: 然后预测这些物体接下来可能会做什么。
cues.en: And then predict what those things might do next.

cues.zh: 而且它不仅对你我能看到的物体这样做。
cues.en: And it doesn't just do that for the objects you and I can see.

cues.zh: 它能对远达三个足球场距离外的物体做到这一点。
cues.en: It can do that for things up to three football fields away.

cues.zh: 你现在看到的一切之所以成为可能，靠的是经验。
cues.en: What makes everything you can see right now possible is experience.

cues.zh: Waymo已经在复杂的城市街道上自动驾驶了数百万英里
cues.en: Waymo has already self-driven millions of miles on complicated city streets

cues.zh: 并且从行驶的每一英里中不断学习。
cues.en: and it's constantly learning from every single mile it drives.

cues.zh: 凭借所有这些知识，它能规划出一条安全的前进路线。
cues.en: With all that knowledge, it can plan a safe path ahead.

cues.zh: 在这个场景中，给那位骑行者留出足够的空间骑过去
cues.en: In this instance, giving that cyclist enough room to cycle past us

cues.zh: 同时留意人行道上的那位行人
cues.en: and also looking out for that pedestrian on the sidewalk

cues.zh: 而在做决策方面，这是一个很好的例子
cues.en: And when it comes to making decisions, this is a good example

cues.zh: 说明Waymo不仅考虑你的安全，
cues.en: of how Waymo doesn't just take into account your safety,

cues.zh: 还确保你和周围的人都能感到安心和自在。
cues.en: it also makes sure that both you, and the people around you feel secure and at ease.

cues.zh: 现在你了解了 Waymo 的工作原理，是时候坐上我们的车体验第一次出行了。
cues.en: So now that you know how Waymo works, it's time to take your first ride in one of our cars.

cues.zh: 四处看看。
cues.en: Take a look around.

cues.zh: 你现在乘坐的是一辆完全自动驾驶的汽车。
cues.en: You're now riding in a fully self-driving car.

cues.zh: 有些地方可能一眼就会引起你的注意。
cues.en: Some things might immediately stand out.

cues.zh: 比如驾驶座上没有人，没有人转动方向盘。
cues.en: The fact that there's no one in the driver's seat, no one turning the wheel.

cues.zh: 还有屏幕，会向你展示车辆看到的内容以及行驶的路线。
cues.en: And the screens, which show you what the car is seeing and the route it's taking.

cues.zh: 但你也许还会注意到，这趟行程感觉很像坐在普通汽车里由人驾驶。
cues.en: But you might also notice that the ride feels a lot like being driven in a regular car.

cues.zh: 本来就该是这种感觉。
cues.en: And that's the way it should feel.

cues.zh: 所有这些技术，让 Waymo 能够看见、识别、预测和规划
cues.en: All this technology, which allows Waymo to see, identify, predict and plan

cues.zh: 应该让一次非凡的出行感觉完全平常。
cues.en: should make an extraordinary ride feel completely ordinary.

cues.zh: 打造一段再普通不过的旅程，安稳地把你从 A 点送到 B 点。
cues.en: And create a very normal journey that simply gets you from A to B safe and sound.

cues.zh: 而它做这一切的时候，你只需靠坐放松，享受旅程。
cues.en: And while it does all that, all you have to do is sit back, relax and enjoy the ride.
